title: Privacy & Security in Online Social Media
standfirst: The threat models, defences and design choices behind privacy on today's social platforms.

resources.label: Course notes
resources.desc: Notes and study material for this course.

resources.label: Degree level notes on Medium
resources.desc: Notes for several degree courses collected on one page. Look for this course's section.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces the practical aspects of large-scale analytics (big data), beginning with foundational concepts in big data and cloud computing across hardware, systems, and software, and progressing to algorithm design and execution at scale.
faculty: Prof. Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Department of Computer Science, IIIT Hyderabad

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Course overview; Social network analysis; Social media impact; Network metrics; Research projects.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Data collection; Twitter API; Historical and live tweets; Reddit data.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Social media text; Text processing; NLP libraries; Feature extraction.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Fake news basics; Types; Concepts; Detection methods.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Fake news research; Content-based detection; Misinformation datasets; Mitigation strategies.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Social media policing; Privacy and security; Identity resolution.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Social media nudges; Cybercrime; Hate speech detection.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Privacy in social media; Information disclosure; Personally identifiable information (PII).

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Ethics in social media research; Ethical challenges and solutions; Bias in social media research.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Research paper discussions; Network centrality measures (degree, closeness, betweenness).
